description: A white table lamp with a classic silhouette. The lampshade is conical, tapering towards the top. The base of the lamp features an ornate, spherical element with intricate embossed patterns, possibly floral or geometric in design. A delicate, stylized butterfly ornament is attached to the side of the lampshade, adding a whimsical and decorative touch. The overall design suggests a blend of traditional elegance and charming detail, making it suitable for various interior settings.
